synthesis.headline: Management dropped multiple strategic revenue targets while ongoing promises remain unverifiable against financials.

points.text: Management dropped key long-term revenue targets for FY27 and FY31 after mentioning them in Jan 2026.
The FY27 Q4 revenue run rate target introduced in Apr 2026 was subsequently dropped and not repeated.
Annual revenue scaled from 4188.0 crore in Mar 2021 to 14748.0 crore in Mar 2026, alongside operating margin improving to 19.0%.
Quarterly operating margins declined from 19.4% in Dec 2025 down to 13.6% by Sep 2026.

bull.text: Annual PAT expanded consistently from 451.0 crore in Mar 2021 to 1865.0 crore by Mar 2026.
Cash from operations grew strongly to 1767.0 crore for Mar 2026, maintaining a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.07.

bear.text: Management repeatedly drops quantitative guidance horizons, rendering future target tracking unreliable.
Working capital days increased to 50.0 in Sep 2026 from 20.0 previously.
